headings: FASHIONABLY LONDON SCENT DIFFUSER 90ML (3.04 FL. OZ.)

jsonld_raw.name: FASHIONABLY LONDON SCENT DIFFUSER 90ML (3.04 FL. OZ.)
jsonld_raw.description:
A scented home diffuser featuring the iconic Fashionably London fragrance, designed to fill your space with an elegant, contemporary atmosphere. Inspired by London's relaxed sophistication, this scent blends the luminous freshness of bergamot with the modern femininity of rose and the enveloping softness of musk.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Musky Floral | Elegant, luminous, and contemporary
